adjudication.rationale:
In Admin::GroupsController#remove_member the diff shows `group.users.delete(user_id)` followed by `if group.save ... else ...`.

`group.users.delete(user_id)` removes the association directly rather than going through a domain method like `group.remove(user)` (which is used elsewhere in the codebase, e.g. older controller logic and is invoked from the JS model via `removeMember`). Using `delete` can bypass join-model `destroy` callbacks and any counter-cache/touch behavior that would run on `destroy`/custom remove logic.

Also, calling `group.save` immediately afterward is likely redundant because no group attributes are being modified in this method; therefore the `render_json_error` branch is unlikely to ever be exercised (though not provably impossible if validations could fail). This is a concrete maintainability/logic concern, but the diff alone doesn’t prove it causes incorrect behavior in this app.
